data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Artios, which means 'belonging to Artus', the god of hunting. The name Artie signifies bravery, courage, and strength. In Christian tradition, it can be interpreted as a symbol of faith and dedication. The name Artie carries the meaning “Bold and noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Artie usually hope their child will grow to embody bold and noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual roots, representing the inner strength and courage to overcome life's challenges.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Artie total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
